findings.summary: The retained production-source proof does not compare the pinned commits because both revisions appear after `--`.
findings.diagnosis: Git treats every argument after `--` as a pathspec, so `git diff -- src/agentmap 8b12f714...529393ac` compares the worktree/index for three path names instead of comparing the base and implementation revisions. Its empty output therefore cannot support the recorded production-source-diff claim, even though an independent correctly ordered comparison confirms the claim is true for this candidate.
findings.evidence: Line 1 records `git diff -- src/agentmap 8b12f714f041d6162dfb40eb1b8851291a5dfe26..529393acb6facf2482184ef4b22e22bbadd9f995`; the revisions are positioned after the pathspec separator. Running `git diff 8b12f714f041d6162dfb40eb1b8851291a5dfe26..529393acb6facf2482184ef4b22e22bbadd9f995 -- src/agentmap` is the comparison that establishes the intended result.
findings.correction: Regenerate the retained log with `git diff 8b12f714f041d6162dfb40eb1b8851291a5dfe26..529393acb6facf2482184ef4b22e22bbadd9f995 -- src/agentmap` and retain its empty output with the corrected command line.
